minorfeasts-3-feasts-commemoration-midni: Tawakkaltu 'alayka ya Yasou' el-Maseeh Ibn Allah, akhta'tu ilayka, ighfir li min agl walidat el-Ilah.
Hulla 'anni a'mal khatayaya, la tasrif waghak 'anni ayyuha el-Maseeh muhibb el-bashar.
Li-annaka atayta ila batn el-'Adhra', wa anta er-ra'ees wal-khaliq.
Haqqan akhbarana Louqa bit-tahleel bi-sirr 'Emmanoueel.
Li-dhalika qala 'an Ghabriyal khadim el-aqdas el-mubashshir lil-'Adhra'.
Qad takallama ma'aha qa'ilan: es-salamu laki ayyatuha el-mumtali'a ni'ma en-naqiyya.
Huwadha el-'abda waladat el-Ibn, Ibn el-'Aliyy, Yasou' lahu el-'izza.
Laka el-quwwa wal-baraka ayyuha el-Maseeh edh-dhati, alladhi ashraqa el-yawm fi batn el-'Adhra'.
Yasou' muhibb el-bashar ashraqa gasadiyyan, ka-bushra Ghabriyal el-malak.
Hasanan bil-haqeeqa sara Ibn bashar, huwa el-Ilah el-haqeeqi malik es-sama' wal-ard.
Qoulou ayyuha el-anbiya' wes-siddiqoun, li-anna el-Maseeh es-sayyid ata ila el-'alam.
Fal-yaftakhir el-yawm Ibrahim el-'azeem, wa kull abna'ihi wa gins Adam.
Irhamna wasma'na ayyuha el-waheed el-gins, malik ed-duhour, naggina min shada'idina.
Mubarakun anta ya malikana, hamal Allah, malik el-mulouk, alladhi ga'a li-agl khalasina.
Sirr Allah el-Kalima zahara lana min el-'Adhra'.
El-wahid min eth-Thalouth el-muqaddas tagassada el-yawm min el-qiddisa.
Famuna imtala'a farahan, er-Rabb ga'a ilayna, wa 'ubudiyyatuna el-murra inhallat 'anna.
Isma'na warhamna ayyuha es-salih, kun ma'ana, anta mu'eenuna.
Nasgudu laka ayyuha er-rahoum dhou el-ism el-hulw, bi-tawadu' qalb wa rukab munhaniya.
Ya Ibn Allah irhamni ana el-khati', a'tini el-khalas, li-anni akmaltu el-khataya.
Allah muhibb el-bashar taweel er-rouh, alladhi sara insanan min agl ra'fatihi.
Ighfir athamana bi-shafa'at ummika el-kulliyyat el-qadasa el-'azeema Maryam.
Kull el-anfus tusabbih Allah el-khaliq, wa tursil et-tasbeeh li-sahib el-karama.
Ta'anna 'alayna wasma' salawatina, ya Rabb ihfazna min el-fakhkh el-mansoub.
